payload.core_mechanism_summary: Linear scan counts fixed points (i == a[i]) and sets flag m=1 if any i != a[i] satisfies i == a[a[i]] (2-cycle). Outputs min(k + 1 + m, n).
payload.rationale: The solution uses an ad-hoc greedy observation, not actual search. Among given subtypes, search_permutation_enumeration relates to permutation problems but does not reflect the O(n) scanning approach.
